key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:end:0:CFFC
name: receive_port_message_into_state
description: Waits on a message port with a long timeout, then copies the message header words and a large record block into the state area. After the copies it calls a library routine to finish with the message.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:end:0:D0CE
name: copy_record_relocate_pointer_table
description: Copies a header and several record blocks from a message into the state area using unrolled copy loops with fixed counts. It then fills a table by adding a base address to each stored offset and copies a further byte range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:end:0:D250
name: set_global_byte_to_255
description: Stores the value 255 into a single global byte and returns. Nothing else happens in the code shown.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:0000
name: run_blitter_setup_sequence
description: Clears a counter, calls initialisation routines through a function table, and programs the blitter control and size registers. It waits until the blitter busy flag clears, then copies values into fixed offsets and calls more routines in order.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:0006
name: copy_table_and_patch_bytes
description: Copies a large block of bytes from a source table into a buffer whose pointer is held in the state. When a flag in the state is set, it adds 2 to two bytes at each of 27 addresses listed in a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:219C6
name: run_blit_step_with_counter
description: Decrements a step counter and returns an all-ones value once it has run out. Otherwise it programs the blitter, waits for it to finish, calls several routines and returns a result value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:219F0
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination until a zero byte has been copied. The terminating zero is copied as well.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21A14
name: append_signed_word_as_text
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to decimal text, writing a minus sign first when the value is negative. The digits are built in groups and appended with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21AA2
name: format_three_digit_number_text
description: Writes the low word of the input as three decimal digits into a small buffer, after first storing an address taken from a register-indexed table. The buffer is then appended with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21AE6
name: append_value_using_subtraction_table
description: Converts a value to decimal by repeated subtraction against a table of decimal place values, writing a minus sign for negative input. The digits are appended to the end of the destination string, which is then terminated.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21B50
name: write_fixed_width_decimal_digits
description: Writes a fixed number of decimal digits of the input into a buffer, finding each digit by repeated subtraction against a table. The buffer is then appended with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21B64
name: write_counted_decimal_digits
description: Writes a counted run of decimal digits, each found by repeated subtraction against a table, and zero-terminates the text. The text is then appended to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:21B76
name: show_text_after_blit_step
description: Runs a counter-guarded blitter step that programs the blitter registers, waits for it to go idle and calls a set of routines. It then picks a text string by comparing an uppercased input character with a stored one, measures that string and passes it to further routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:22204
name: call_handler_per_list_entry
description: Stores a flag byte in the state, calls two routines, then restores a second flag byte. It loops over a zero-terminated list, calling an indirect routine with the current value and adding 12 to that value after each call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:22208
name: call_handler_per_list_entry
description: Stores a flag byte in the state, calls two routines, then restores a second flag byte. It loops over a zero-terminated list, calling an indirect routine with the current value and adding 12 to that value after each call.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:22238
name: call_handler_until_zero_byte
description: Repeatedly calls an indirect routine with the current value, adding 12 to the value after each call. The loop ends when the byte at the list pointer is zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:2224E
name: fade_color_table_toward_zero
description: Steps a table of 23 colour words toward zero in each of its three 4-bit channels, five times, calling routines between steps. It copies each stepped value into a second table, sets a global word and returns the low channel of the last value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:26682
name: pulse_color_value_loop
description: Calls a routine on each pass and, every few passes, steps a 12-bit colour value up or down by 273. The direction reverses at the limits 0 and 4095, and the stepped value is stored in a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:267E6
name: store_indexed_long_through_pointer
description: Stores a 16-bit index into a state field, then looks up an offset in a table by that index. It writes the 32-bit value found at the state base plus that offset through a stored pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:select:0:26870
name: reset_state_words_to_defaults
description: Sets several 16-bit state words to zero and two others to the all-ones value. It makes no calls and returns at once.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0000
name: initialise_game_state_block
description: Sets several flag bytes and words, fills a 128-byte area of the state with the value 128, and copies the first longs of the state into global storage. It then calls a set of initialisation routines in sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0006
name: initialise_sprites_and_dma_state
description: Clears flags and a 128-byte area in the state block, copies longs into global storage and calls setup routines. It also writes sprite data and DMA control registers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:01FC
name: set_word_max_if_zero
description: When a global value is zero, sets a global word to the all-ones value. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:020E
name: add_eight_to_record_bytes
description: Adds 8 to a byte at the start of each of 88 consecutive 8-byte records in a global table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0226
name: initialise_game_variables
description: Calls setup routines, then copies position values from the state into several globals. It also sets a block of global counters, speeds and limits to fixed constants.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:05DC
name: initialise_object_table_entries
description: When a state flag is clear, it sets speed and timing globals and fills a table of object records. Each record gets computed x and y positions shifted left by five bits and a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:072C
name: save_and_replace_pointer_target
description: Saves the 32-bit value at a pointer taken from the state into a global, then overwrites that location with a code address.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0742
name: restore_saved_pointer_target
description: Writes the saved 32-bit global value back to the pointer taken from the state. It pairs with the routine that saved and replaced it.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0750
name: update_timing_and_scroll_state
description: Advances a pointer, steps a timing counter that picks values from a table, and counts intervals of 50 or 60 ticks depending on a state flag. It also writes the playfield scroll register from a stored value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:07AC
name: apply_display_registers_on_interval
description: Counts intervals up to 50 ticks and, on each one, updates a counter and a stored value. It then writes display window, fetch and bitplane modulo registers from the saved state and sets the zero colour register.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:085E
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: This code is a stub: it writes four fixed words into the state, then decodes as bad data, so the rest of the routine cannot be recovered.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:087C
name: write_four_values_through_pointers
description: Stores four saved global values into the memory locations that four stored pointers point to.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:08AE
name: relocate_two_pointer_tables
description: Sets a flag bit in a byte, then adds a base address to every entry of two tables. The entry counts are taken from globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:08D2
name: relocate_two_pointer_tables
description: Adds a base address to every entry of two tables. The entry counts are taken from globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:08F8
name: dispatch_handlers_for_active_slots
description: Clears two globals, then loops over four 24-byte slots and calls a routine for each slot that is nonzero. It then does the same for two further slots, calling a handler stored at offset 8 in each.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0936
name: find_smallest_matching_record
description: Scans 86-byte records for one whose flag bits match and whose check routine returns nonzero, keeping the one with the smallest returned value. When none matches, it increments a counter and updates a value from a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:09BA
name: copy_record_fields_to_slot
description: When the check routine returns zero, it calls five routines and then copies three 16-bit fields from a record into a slot chosen from a value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0A0E
name: advance_record_by_table_speed
description: Advances an item counter up to its limit and derives a speed from a table, scaled by a global divisor. It adds that speed to the record's position fields and keeps the position below a limit of 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0A20
name: update_record_with_target_search
description: When a field is negative, it searches a list for the closest candidate and stores its address in the record. When a check passes, it reduces a value by 4096 divided by a global divisor, increments a counter and updates the record position from a table.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0A6E
name: copy_record_fields_after_checks
description: When one check routine returns nonzero and a second returns zero, it calls five routines, copies a global, and copies three 16-bit fields from a record into globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0A78
name: decay_record_speed_and_copy
description: When a check fails, it reduces a speed value by 4096 divided by a global divisor and increments a counter. When another check passes, it calls routines and copies three fields from the record into globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0AB0
name: copy_record_fields_when_clear
description: When a check routine returns zero, it calls five routines and copies three 16-bit fields from a record into globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0B0A
name: step_position_toward_clamped_target
description: Clamps an offset from a stored target to a limit, then steps position and speed fields by that offset scaled by a global divisor. It copies three record fields when a check passes and the distance is within the limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0B1C
name: step_position_toward_clamped_target
description: Clamps an input offset to a limit, then steps position and speed fields by it scaled by a global divisor. It copies three record fields when a check passes and the distance is within the limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0B58
name: step_axis_with_distance_check
description: Clamps an input offset, steps a position field by that offset scaled by a global divisor, and runs a check. When the check passes and the distance is within a limit, it copies three fields and returns minus one, otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0B7A
name: check_distance_and_copy_fields
description: Takes the absolute value of an offset and, when its sum with a second offset lies within a limit, copies three fields from a record and returns minus one. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0BC0
name: call_record_handler
description: Calls the routine whose address is stored at offset 16 in the record pointed to by the input. It is a single indirect call with no other work.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0BC6
name: check_target_hit_and_update
description: Sets a timer field to 10 and calls a routine, then tests a flag bit and calls a check whose result gates a distance comparison. Within range it clamps offsets, calls routines and updates record fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0D72
name: decay_speed_and_advance_position
description: Reduces a speed value by 4096 divided by a global divisor and increments a counter up to its limit. It then derives speed from a table, updates the position and a second axis, and keeps the position below a limit of 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0D8A
name: advance_record_by_table_speed
description: Advances an item counter up to its limit and derives a speed from a table, scaled by a global divisor. It adds that speed to the record's position fields and keeps the position below a limit of 30000.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_position_within_range
description: Compares the record's position with a reference position. Within a wide range it returns minus one and sets a state word to 3, and within a narrow range it also sets a byte to all ones. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_position_band_range
description: Compares the record's position with a reference and tests whether the distance lies outside a band derived from a global value. When it does, it returns minus one and sets a state word to 13, and it sets a byte to all ones when a second distance is small.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0F5A
name: check_position_band_range
description: Compares the record's position with a reference and tests whether the distance lies outside a band derived from a global value. When it does, it returns minus one and sets a state word to 4, and it sets a byte to all ones when a second distance is small.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:0FA8
name: register_object_once_flagged
description: If a flag bit in the record is clear, it sets the bit, stores a handler pointer, and copies three position words into globals. It then runs routines and clears a status field, returning zero, and returns minus one when the flag was already set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:103E
name: register_slot_pointer_once
description: Returns minus one if a flag bit in the record is already set. Otherwise it sets the bit, clears a field and stores the record in one of two slot globals, updating the slot state from that slot's value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1168
name: advance_counter_when_flag_clear
description: When a global flag is zero, it adds one plus a stored value to a counter and sets another global to 14.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:118E
name: test_record_in_proximity_band
description: Returns zero when a threshold from the record is at or below the input and the record's position is within a band around a reference. Otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:11AC
name: test_position_inside_band
description: Returns zero when the record's position lies inside a band around a reference, with the band derived from a global value. Otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:11D6
name: test_position_outside_range
description: Returns zero when a threshold from the record is at or below the input and the record's position is more than 8192 away from the reference. Otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:11F4
name: test_position_outside_range
description: Returns zero when the record's position is more than 8192 away from the reference. Otherwise it returns minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:120A
name: update_record_timers_in_table
description: Loops over 50-byte records, skipping inactive ones and clearing a flag bit on them. For active records it counts down a timer, reloads it from a division by a computed value, and calls a routine when the timer reaches 4 under a global condition.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1280
name: start_firing_sequence_from_record
description: When a check routine returns nonzero, it copies the record's position and flags into globals and picks a timer from the record's value. It then sets the record's state fields and selects a step size from a flag, and the routine refers to the text FIRING.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:146A
name: compute_scaled_record_value
description: When a state word is neither zero nor minus one, it calls a routine and returns a value scaled from a record field and a global. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:14B6
name: call_handler_for_each_record
description: Saves the previous global value, clears the current one, then calls the handler stored at offset 32 for each record in a table, stepping by 86 bytes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:14E8
name: select_nearest_flagged_record
description: When a counter is below a limit and a distance exceeds a threshold, it scans 50-byte records whose flag bits match and keeps the one with the smallest returned value. It then calls two routines for that record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1576
name: update_record_motion_and_state
description: Increments a field toward its limit and, when a check value is below 17, copies a field and stores a handler pointer. Unless a flag is set, it clamps horizontal and vertical offsets from record fields to limits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:15DE
name: initialise_record_motion_fields
description: Sets a field to the maximum 16-bit value and computes a distance to a linked record plus offsets. When a check value is below 17 it sets a flag bit, stores a handler pointer, zeroes motion fields and sets a counter to 12.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1678
name: step_record_motion_each_frame
description: Sets a field to the maximum value, then either decrements a counter by a scaled amount or, when it reaches zero, clears flags and re-sets handler pointers. It also computes a table-based velocity from record fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:169A
name: step_record_velocity_from_table
description: Clears a flag bit and, once a counter reaches its limit, sets flag bits and handler pointers. It then computes velocity components from a table indexed by record fields, scaled by a divisor.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:16B6
name: set_record_velocity_from_table
description: Sets flag bits and handler pointers in the record, then computes two velocity components from table values indexed by record fields and scaled by a divisor.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:16D0
name: ramp_record_speed_and_velocity
description: Resets or raises a field depending on a threshold, then ramps a speed field up by a scaled step until a limit is reached. It then computes velocity components from a table indexed by record fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:16DE
name: ramp_record_speed_and_velocity
description: Raises a speed field by a scaled step until a limit is reached, then computes velocity components from a table indexed by record fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1708
name: set_velocity_and_restore_handler
description: Clears a flag bit, restores a stored handler pointer into the record, and computes velocity components from table values indexed by record fields.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1718
name: update_tracked_object_state
description: Ramps a timer field and, while a global count is below a limit, measures the record's distance from a reference to gate further updates. It calls several routines and copies fields when the distance tests pass.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1904
name: compute_clamped_steering_target
description: Chooses a target value from an input value, with a special case for one input code, then clamps the value and an offset to limits. It writes the result toward a stored target field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1940
name: step_field_toward_clamped_target
description: Clamps a difference to a limit and steps a field by that difference scaled by a global divisor. It then computes an offset from a stored target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1960
name: acquire_nearest_target_record
description: When a flag bit is clear and a modulo test passes, it measures a distance and searches up to eight candidate records for one within a threshold. When none is in range it clears flags and stores a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:197C
name: acquire_nearest_target_record
description: Measures a distance and searches up to eight candidate records for one within a threshold. When none is in range it clears flags and stores a handler pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A14
name: search_targets_within_distance
description: Loops up to a count, measuring distances to candidate records until one falls within both distance limits, and updates the matched record's fields. It then ramps a timer and calls routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_record_handler_and_flags
description: Stores a handler pointer in the record, clears a flag mask, and zeroes a field. It returns at once.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_scaled_offset_after_updates
description: Calls three routines, then returns the difference between an input position and a stored field, shifted right by five bits.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A6A
name: stub_empty_return
description: This routine does nothing and returns at once, so it has no behaviour to recover.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A7A
name: step_record_position_toward_input
description: Clamps the difference between an input position and a stored field to a limit, then steps the speed and position fields by a scaled amount. It then updates a second position field with a clamped offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A88
name: step_record_position_toward_input
description: Clamps the difference between an input position and a stored field to a limit, then steps the speed and position fields by a scaled amount. It then updates a second position field with a clamped offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1A98
name: step_record_position_toward_input
description: Limits an input value to a negative bound, steps the speed and position fields toward it by a scaled amount, and updates a second position field with a clamped offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1AB0
name: step_record_position_with_wrap
description: Steps a speed and position pair from an input value and clamps an offset to a limit. It wraps the stored values by 32768 when the offset magnitude exceeds 16384.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1AF0
name: update_record_position_and_velocity
description: Clamps an input value, steps an offset, and wraps position fields when the offset is too large. It then computes velocity components from a table indexed by record fields and writes them to the record.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1E7E
name: store_record_into_slot_table
description: Copies three fields from a record into globals and, when a flag value is low, clears flags and stores a handler pointer. It saves the record into one of eight slots chosen by a counter, then calls another routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialise_record_from_template
description: Sets a field from a global and copies position fields from an input template, offset by a global value, with a second layout used when a flag bit is set. It then sets counter fields on the record to fixed starting values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:1FFA
name: set_scale_divisor_from_setting
description: Clamps a setting between 4 and 15, halving it when a flag is set, and stores the result as the divisor. It also derives two globals from the divisor and calls several routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_countdown_timers_and_return
description: Decrements two countdown globals when they are nonzero and returns the low byte of the input register unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_countdown_timers
description: Decrements two countdown globals when they are nonzero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:20F6
name: advance_moving_objects_by_velocity
description: Loops over four records that have a countdown, decrementing it and adding each velocity to its position words. It measures each record's distance from a reference and sets a value computed from 75 divided by a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:22C2
name: advance_or_clear_record_slots
description: When a global pointer is negative, it clears one slot of eight in a table and returns its offset. Otherwise it advances eight records by adding increments to their position and velocity words.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:234C
name: decay_and_apply_offset_value
description: When a global value is positive, it reduces a second global by 12 while it stays above minus 16, then adds it to the first global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:2372
name: store_value_and_call_routine
description: Stores the input word and a stored value into two state fields, sets a global byte to 255 and calls another routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_and_convert_position_globals
description: Derives two position globals by shifting two other globals right by five bits, then clamps each to a range and resets its companion value when it hits a limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:2466
name: save_positions_and_raise_minimums
description: Copies four globals into a second set of globals, then raises a field in each active record to at least a value derived from a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_nearest_flagged_record
description: Loops over records whose flag bits match, measures the distance from a reference position and keeps the nearest one. The chosen record pointer is stored in a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:259C
name: call_handler_if_present
description: Clears a global, then calls a routine and returns its result only when a pointer field in the input is nonzero. It clears the global again before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:25A0
name: call_handler_if_present
description: Clears a global, then calls a routine and returns its result only when a pointer field in the input is nonzero. It clears the global again before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:25E6
name: initialise_slot_record_with_velocity
description: When the target record's flag bit is clear, it resets a slot's status word and sets handler pointers and initial fields. It adds a velocity of 12288 to a long field, negated when a direction value is negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:266C
name: find_closest_record_to_target
description: Loops over the record table, skipping the excluded record and inactive ones, and measures each record's distance from a reference. It keeps the closest match.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:2710
name: find_closest_record_within_limit
description: Starts from a stored record and compares its distance with a limit of 4800, then loops over flagged records measuring each distance from a reference. It keeps the closest one and stores the result in a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:5FE6
name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Entry point that decodes into the same range-overlap test as the routine that follows it. It compares a range on one axis with reference bounds and sets bit codes for the edges inside them.

name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Entry point that decodes into the same range-overlap test as the routine that follows it. It compares a range on one axis with reference bounds and sets bit codes for the edges inside them.

name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Entry point that decodes into the same range-overlap test as the routine that follows it. It compares a range on one axis with reference bounds and sets bit codes for the edges inside them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:5FF2
name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Entry point that decodes into the same range-overlap test as the routine that follows it. It compares a range on one axis with reference bounds and sets bit codes for the edges inside them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:5FF6
name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Compares a range on one axis with reference bounds and builds bit codes for the edges that fall inside them.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:62B2
name: classify_rectangle_overlap_bits
description: Compares ranges on two axes with reference bounds and builds bit codes for the edges inside, adding bits from a third comparison. It calls five routines to supply values while doing so.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:63C6
name: take_absolute_values_and_return
description: Takes the absolute values of two input words and then returns without storing anything. The comparison in the code does not change any output.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:63F6
name: compare_inputs_against_bounds
description: Compares an input with zero and with a magnitude derived from a second input. The decompiled body shows only early returns, so no stored result is visible.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:64B0
name: compare_inputs_against_bounds
description: Compares an unsigned input with zero and with a magnitude derived from a second input. The decompiled body shows only early returns, so no stored result is visible.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:65A8
name: append_entry_to_record_list
description: Appends a five-byte-plus entry to a list when space remains, storing a frame counter, the high bits of two position values and two input bytes. The list pointer then advances past the entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:65EA
name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source pointer to a destination until a zero byte has been copied. The terminating zero is copied as well.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:65F8
name: append_zero_terminated_string
description: Finds the end of the destination string and copies the source string there, including its terminating zero.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:660C
name: append_signed_word_as_text
description: Converts a signed 16-bit value to decimal text, writing a minus sign first when the value is negative. The digits are built in groups and appended with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:6654
name: format_number_with_comma
description: Formats a number as decimal digits with a comma after the first group, then appends the text with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:669A
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: This code is a stub: it stores one long from a table at an offset, then decodes as bad data, so the rest of the routine cannot be recovered.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:66A2
name: format_three_digit_number_text
description: Writes the low word of the input as three decimal digits into a small buffer, then appends it with a terminating zero to the end of the destination string.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:66D6
name: select_record_or_global_coordinate
description: Returns a 16-bit field from the record when a flag bit is clear. Otherwise it returns one of two globals plus 256, chosen by a check routine's result.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:6700
name: match_record_nibble_to_globals
description: Compares the low four bits of a record field with two global values. It returns minus one when either matches and zero when neither does.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:671C
name: clear_buffer_and_uppercase_text
description: Fills a 48-byte text buffer with spaces, then converts lowercase letters in the buffer to uppercase up to that limit.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:68BC
name: pack_table_lookups_into_words
description: For each row of four-bit indexes until a zero index, it looks up table bytes, packs the four results into one word and writes that word twice to the output.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:692A
name: or_mask_into_table_entries
description: When a counter is positive, it decrements the counter and ORs a mask into several table entries at offsets from a base address. It works from copies of nine saved values.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:6934
name: or_mask_into_table_entries
description: ORs a mask into several table entries at offsets from a base address, working from copies of nine saved values. Each pass decrements a counter when it is positive.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:6D2A
name: copy_saved_values_into_record
description: When a counter is zero, it copies a set of saved 32-bit values from globals into fixed offsets of a record referenced through a pointer.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:713A
name: copy_saved_values_into_record
description: Copies a set of saved 32-bit values from globals into fixed offsets of a record referenced through a pointer, without any counter check.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:722A
name: multiply_then_swap_word_halves
description: Calls a routine for a 16-bit value, multiplies it by the input word, and returns the 32-bit product with its two 16-bit halves swapped.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:723C
name: advance_linear_random_seed
description: Multiplies a global seed by 41 and adds 73 to advance a pseudo-random sequence.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:725E
name: record_candidate_if_below_limit
description: When an input value is at or below a limit and a count is below six, it stores a scaled count, the input value and the input pointer as the current candidate.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl](disk 1 of 2)[a2]/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL](Disk 1 of 2)[a2].adf:game:0:728A
